# telnyx_storage_kv_keys (Data Source)

Lists storage kv keys, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_storage_kv_key`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_storage_kv_keys" "flags" {
  namespace_id = telnyx_storage_kv_namespace.flags.id
  prefix       = "feature-"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace_id` (String) The namespace id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `prefix` (String)

### Read-Only

- `storage_kv_keys` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_kv_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--storage_kv_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `storage_kv_keys`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size of the stored value in bytes.
- `updated_at` (String)
